_comment: Teacher resources data. This drives the 'For Teachers' section. Two main cards: TGT/PGT Maths and Circulars/Formats. Changes here will reflect on /for-teachers, /for-teachers/tgt-pgt, and /for-teachers/circular-formats. Each mainCard.subCards item can be a folder (hasSubCards:true with nested subCards) or a leaf resource (with driveUrl).
